summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ performs a prefix test via ref.startswith(str(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in stored term URIs), using node-type-aware equality, and _RDFNamespace inherits it. Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership on Namespace, RDFS/RDF closed membership (positive, negative, plain string and Literal cases, container form _1), and SH. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
